title: Will the lamp switch on?
instruction: The rule: switch on when it is dark AND the motion sensor detects something.

items.text: Dark, someone is walking around the room

items.why: There is no movement. With “and”, both parts must be true.
It isn’t dark; the first part is not true.

items.text: Dark, a cat ran past the sensor
items.why: A motion sensor can’t tell a cat from a person. To the program it is movement.

debrief: With AND, the lamp switches on only when both conditions are true. Otherwise it saves its battery.
